customer_tier.description: vip / regular / new by lifetime spend.

model.analytics.int_customer_orders.compiled_sql:
with order_stats as (
    select
        customer_id,
        count(*) as order_count,
        sum(amount) as total_spent
    from "analytics"."staging"."stg_orders"
    group by 1
)
select
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    coalesce(o.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    coalesce(o.total_spent, 0) as total_spent,
    case
        when coalesce(o.total_spent, 0) > 1000 then 'vip'
        when coalesce(o.total_spent, 0) > 100 then 'regular'
        else 'new'
    end as customer_tier
from "analytics"."staging"."stg_customers" as c
left join order_stats as o
    on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
model.analytics.int_customer_orders.description: Customer grain with lifetime order stats.
